_howToEdit: The "Our work" photos, grouped into tabs. Each { ... } block in phases is one tab: title is the tab name, photos is its list. To add a photo, upload it to public_html/images/work/ in cPanel, then copy one photo block, paste it after the last one in that tab, and change image, caption and alt. image is the file path; caption is shown on the photo; alt describes the photo for blind visitors and Google. Before uploading, resize each photo to about 1600 pixels wide and under 500 KB (phone photos are often 3 to 5 MB, which makes the page slow); any free image resizer works. A tab can hold as many photos as you like: the website shows 12 at a time with a Show more button. Put a comma between blocks, but not after the last one. Save the file and reload the website; no rebuild is needed. If the photos disappear, a comma or quote is out of place: paste the file into jsonlint.com to find it.
